data.name: FilePreview_Name
data.value: File Preview

data.name: FilePreview_Desc
data.value: See the PDF or image in a File or Image column on the form — and download, replace or remove it.

data.name: value_Name
data.value: Placed on

data.name: value_Desc
data.value: Any column on the form. The control never reads or writes it — the file comes from the File or Image column named below.

data.name: fileColumn_Name
data.value: File column

data.name: fileColumn_Desc
data.value: Logical name of the File or Image column to show. Blank takes the table’s only File column.

data.name: allowChanges_Name
data.value: Allow replace and remove

data.name: allowChanges_Desc
data.value: On: the file can be replaced (choose or drop a file) and removed. Off: it is shown and downloaded only.

data.name: previewHeight_Name
data.value: Preview height

data.name: previewHeight_Desc
data.value: Height of the preview in pixels, 120 to 2000.

data.name: recordId_Name
data.value: Record ID

data.name: recordId_Desc
data.value: The record’s id, for a host that does not say which record the control is on. Leave blank on a model-driven form.

data.name: recordEntity_Name
data.value: Record table

data.name: recordEntity_Desc
data.value: The record’s table (logical name), with Record ID. Leave blank on a model-driven form.
